displayName: NGO platform: background event failed permanently

documentation.content: A background event (email, SMS, webhook, automation, payment step) failed all its attempts and will not be retried. Find it in Logs Explorer with `jsonPayload.alert="outbox.failed_permanently"`; the entry has eventId, eventType, tenantId and the last error. The outbox_event row keeps status failed and last_error. Fix the cause (for example a connector's credentials); to retry, set the row's status to pending, attempts to 0 and available_at to now(). Handlers that already finished are not run again. Alert name: outbox.failed_permanently.

conditions.displayName: Any outbox event failed permanently in 5 minutes
